subject: Startups
title: Blitzscaling Explained
description: A quick, practical guide to Blitzscaling Explained.

hook.text: Reid Hoffman coined 'blitzscaling': grow so fast that you sacrifice efficiency for speed, because speed wins markets.

buildup.text: The logic: in winner-take-all markets, the first to reach scale wins permanently. Being profitable later is fine.

discovery.text: Amazon blitzscaled for years, losing money while capturing market share.

twist.text: Blitzscaling fails when the market isn't winner-take-all. Burning cash for a commodity product just burns cash.

climax.text: After 2022, the era of blitzscaling cooled. Investors demanded efficiency. 'Grow at all costs' became 'grow efficiently.
